cloudsql.backupRuns.get: To get the status and details of the backup that is restored into the temporary instance.
cloudsql.instances.restoreBackup: To restore a backup run into the temporary instance.
cloudsql.operations.get: To get the status of a long-running operation, such as creating an instance.
cloudsql.users.create: To create the dedicated archival database user on the temporary instance.
cloudsql.users.update: To update a database user on the temporary instance.
compute.globalAddresses.createInternal: To create the internal address range that private service access allocates on the network.
compute.globalAddresses.deleteInternal: To delete the reserved internal address range once private service access is torn down.
compute.globalAddresses.get: To get the reserved address range, so its CIDR can be used in the Cloud SQL egress network policy.
compute.networks.removePeering: To remove the service networking peering from the network when private service access resources are released.
compute.networks.use: To use the network the private service access connection is made on.
servicenetworking.services.addPeering: To add the peering that connects the network to the Cloud SQL service producer network.
servicenetworking.services.deleteConnect: To delete the private service access connection to the Cloud SQL service producer network.
servicenetworking.services.get: To get the state of the private service access connection.

cloudsql.backupRuns.create: To create a backup of an instance that Rubrik created.
cloudsql.backupRuns.delete: To delete a backup of an instance that Rubrik created.
cloudsql.instances.create: To create the temporary instance that a backup is restored into during archival.
cloudsql.instances.delete: To delete the temporary instance once archival finishes.
cloudsql.instances.get: To get the temporary instance, so its state and private IP address can be read.
cloudsql.instances.update: To update the temporary instance, such as to disable its deletion protection before it is deleted or to reapply a database flag.
